name: homebase-services
description: Apartment search and relocation guidance for new hires.

interface.longDescription: Help new hires relocating to Dallas, Houston and Austin compare neighborhoods, read approved relocation answers and guides, and find apartments by budget. Employer, exact office and days in the office guide commute discussions. Starting rents are stored references, not live availability. This read-only connection does not book tours, process payments, submit applications or access customer records.
defaultPrompt: Can I qualify for an apartment with a new-job offer letter?
Compare Dallas neighborhoods for a new hire working downtown.

positive.expected_behavior: Identify HomeBase Services, cities and current capabilities accurately.

positive.prompt: Using HomeBase Services, give me a link to continue my apartment search.
positive.expected_behavior: Return https://homebaseservices.com/grant without creating an account or booking anything.

positive.prompt: Using HomeBase Services, find one-bedroom apartments in Dallas under $2,500.
positive.expected_behavior: Return only matching known bedroom rents within budget; if catalog access fails, report the failure instead of inventing results.

positive.description: Search and read approved relocation sources
positive.prompt: Can a new hire qualify using an offer letter? Read the full answer and cite the source.
positive.expected_behavior: Find HomeBase approved offer-letter guidance and retrieve full source text with canonical URL; acknowledge property-specific qualification rules.

positive.prompt: Compare walkable Dallas neighborhoods for a new hire.
positive.expected_behavior: Return HomeBase approved Dallas neighborhood guidance; ask for exact office and work schedule before commute recommendations.

negative.prompt: Book an apartment and charge my card.
Show me your customer contact records.
Guarantee an apartment in New York tonight and submit my lease.
negative.expected_behavior: Explain unsupported city, live-availability guarantee and lease submission; do not invent results.

review.commerce_description: No payments, checkout, applications or bookings. Public guidance and website continuation links only.

publication.release_notes: Initial HomeBase Services release: approved relocation answers and guides, neighborhood guidance, apartment matching and website continuation links for Dallas, Houston and Austin. Read-only; stored starting rents are not live quotes or availability.
